description: This PHP source file defines the SaleReturn controller class within the Opencart admin extension. It manages functionality related to sale return reports, including displaying the report form, saving settings, generating report data, and rendering result views.

classes.name: SaleReturn
classes.description: Controller class handling sale return reporting in the admin interface, including viewing, saving configurations, and retrieving report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the sale return report form page, setting title, breadcrumbs, and including header/footer views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves configuration settings for the sale return report, including permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the sale return report view with data such as return statuses and grouping options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the sale return report list, primarily calling getReport for data rendering.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates report data based on filters like date range, group, and status, including pagination and returning the rendered view.
